worker.intro: [Auto run] This task is {{index}}/{{total}} of the plan "{{plan}}". It starts in a fresh session, so use the context below.
worker.report:
Do only this task. Nobody is watching: when your turn ends, a judge reads your report and decides the next step.
- Make reversible choices (names, structure, small scope calls) yourself, following the plan notes and the task, and list them under decisions. Do not stop to ask about them.
- Do things that are hard to undo or leave the machine (push, deploy, deleting data, publishing) only when the plan notes or the task say so. If one is needed and not allowed, write status: blocked and stop.
- Before your turn ends, leave a report with the office-task command from the Agent Office task board instructions (without them, the path in the AGENT_OFFICE_TASK environment variable). Writing it again replaces it.

office-task --report {{id}} - <<'EOF'
status: done | blocked
changed: what you changed
verified: checks you ran and their results
decisions: choices you made yourself
needs_human: (only when blocked) the one thing a human must decide, with the options
EOF

Put the same points briefly in your last reply, and do not end with offers or questions such as "Want me to…?"
